snippet.title: Suramon: Open World Monster Battling & Farming Retro RPG Trailer
snippet.description:
Enjoy a new life in Suramon, a land home to slime monsters. Explore an open world, grow your farm, battle slime, & save the day. Coming in 2024. Back the game and preorder on Kickstarter! https://kickstarter.com/projects/solohack3r/suramon-open-world-monster-battling-and-farming-rpg

#indiegame #indiegames #indiegamedev #indiegaming #retrogaming #rpg #rpggames
